canada.title: Fact-checking the B.C. NDP's record — and major parties' promises — on seniors care
canada.summary: The B.C. NDP promised to add 5,400 new long-term care beds to the system in 2024. They also pledged to expand access to home care, to enable seniors who want to live at home to continue to do so. Here’s a look at what they delivered and what the major parties are promising to do if elected.

canada.title: Switch to permanent daylight time means later starts at Bow Valley ski hills
canada.summary: Bow Valley ski resorts are adjusting their operating hours in response to the move to permanent daylight time. The changes will mean later starts and finishes for skiers this winter.

canada.title: 1 dead, 2 injured after multi-vehicle crash in King, Ont.: York police
canada.summary: A person is dead after a crash in the township of King, Ont., early Thursday, York police said.

canada.title: First Nations artists pull art from University of Calgary after event inviting debate on residential schools
canada.summary: Two First Nations artists have pulled their work from the University of Calgary’s gallery in a protest over an event that invited students to debate whether residential schools were an act of genocide.

canada.title: Saskatoon heritage panel debates unapproved deck at century-old house
canada.summary: Owners of a 1917 house with heritage designation say they tried to resolve the issue with city officials before demolishing an existing deck without the proper permission and building a new one.

canada.title: WHL commissioner reviews state of the league in Sask. and beyond
canada.summary: Dan Near speaks about the health of local teams in the changing junior hockey landscape, rising costs, possible expansion, streaming and league safety standards.

canada.title: Electronic tabulators meant fast, and initially confusing, results in Yellowknife election
canada.summary: Electronic tabulators were used for the first time in a Yellowknife municipal election this week, leading to initial results being posted shortly after polls closed and before one candidate's watch party even began.

canada.title: Canadian convicted in U.S. terror plot gets 50 more years for stabbing prison staff
canada.summary: An Ontario man convicted of plotting a terrorist attack in the U.S. has been handed an additional 50-year sentence for stabbing two American prison staff.
canada.outlet: Winnipeg Free Press, CBC News, Global News

canada.title: ‘A terrifying project,’ but there will be no environmental assessment for EverWind’s hyperscale data centre
canada.summary: “It’s obviously being ramrodded right through,” Benjamin said. “It should have a full environmental assessment that will look not just at the immediate physical impacts of building the thing, but also operational impacts on water, on emissions – which will be huge, and on the energy system. It’s a terrifying project."

canada.title: Kevin Klein didn't need to win a debate, he only needed to sideline Mike Vogiatzakis
canada.summary: Kevin Klein's main objective Wednesday was to present himself as the only viable alternative to incumbent candidate Scott Gillingham. Klein missed that opportunity in the morning but succeeded over the supper hour.

canada.title: Officials to provide update on fatal fire at CFB Wainwright in Alberta
canada.summary: Officials are set to provide an update today about a devastating fire at a Canadian military base in Alberta that left four soldiers dead and dozens more injured.

canada.title: Mount Allison brings back teaching-degree program nearly 30 years after nixing it
canada.summary: The university will offer a 16-month post-baccalaureate degree with options to teach either grades K to 5 or 6 to 12.

canada.title: Firm behind planned Anthropic data centre in Nova Scotia denies owing fees to N.L.
canada.summary: EverWind, a company planning a massive data centre in Nova Scotia for artificial intelligence giant Anthropic, is in the midst of a dispute about land fees for a failed wind-powered hydrogen project in southern Newfoundland.

canada.title: Teacher shortage in Happy Valley-Goose Bay linked to housing shortage, says NLTA president
canada.summary: The president of the NLTA says two teachers gave up jobs in Happy Valley-Goose Bay this year because they couldn't find housing—and he's calling on the provincial government to offer clear solutions.

canada.title: MUN international students down by 45% after federal restrictions
canada.summary: The number of international students at Memorial University has dropped 45 per cent in the past three years, following a federal clamp down on study permits.

canada.title: He bought a used SUV from a Volvo dealer. He regrets trusting their inspection process
canada.summary: Ashton-Vitaly Evdosin, a 21-year-old student says he's had continuous problems with his certified pre-owned Volvo since he bought it last fall. None of the problems were flagged in the dealership's inspection report. He wants Volvo Canada to cancel the vehicle sale and refund his money.

canada.title: Taking the road less travelled by: Montreal rideshare driver releases poetry collection
canada.summary: After eight years of balancing 10-hour workdays and writing, Jibril Adamu is releasing his first poetry collection, Ode to a Red Country Rooster, at the end of the month.

canada.title: B.C. food banks see usage double since 2019, as advocate calls for provincial parties to do more
canada.summary: Food banks in B.C. have seen their usage double compared to the pre-COVID-19 pandemic year of 2019, according to a report. It's led to calls for better income assistance in the province, and more action on grocery prices, from a homelessness support organization.
